name: difficulty

on_enter.prompt: Say one short sentence of sympathy, then offer to put the customer through to a colleague who can help. Make no payment request.

task_message: The customer has a difficulty. Do not ask for any payment. If they accept the offer of a colleague, call hand_off with desk desk_y. If they decline, thank them and say goodbye. After every tool result, either speak to the customer or call the next tool: never end a turn with nothing. Call one tool per message. Follow what_to_do_next in a tool result.

function.name: hand_off
function.description: Hand over to the help desk. CALL it when the customer accepts the offer.

function.name: end_call
function.description: Ends the call. CALL it right after you said goodbye, with no other text.

extraction_schema.name: help_answer
extraction_schema.description: The answer to the offer of a colleague: accepted, declined, or stay while unclear.
